dz: 尼禄在引用维吉尔的《埃涅阿斯纪》后自杀身亡，从而结束了胡利奥-克劳迪安王朝并开始了被称为四皇年的内战。
de: Nero dies by suicide after quoting Vergil's Aeneid, thus ending the Julio-Claudian dynasty and starting the civil war known as the Year of the Four Emperors.
